notes.title: Hot fixes for last update
notes.content: Fixed a bug that caused issues with obtaining achievements for collecting cats.

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1.020
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 💖[/p][p]A new update with improvements and fixes is out! 🐾[/p][p]🛠 What's new:[/p][p]✨ Daily quests: timer reduced to 4 hours.
✨ Updated button layout in the game.
✨ Added achievements for the cat collection.
✨ Added achievements for collecting love.[/p][p]🛠 Fixes:[/p][p]✅ Fixed renaming bug — everything now works correctly.
✅ Fixed bug when purchasing new locations related to achievements.
✅ Fixed long-sale balance.
✅ Removed bugs with trash in the “Desert” location.
✅ Fixed localization in long-sale.[/p][p]Thank you all for your support! 💖
Hope your kitties are full and happy! 🐾[/p]

notes.title: Cats Are Money Hotfix 1.019
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! 💖

🛠 A new hotfix has just been released to fix some issues and add a few small improvements. Thank you for playing and supporting the game!
-------------------------------------------------------
✅Fixed the bug with the non-working "No" button on exit.
✅Fixed an exploit that allowed bypassing the timer in daily quests.
✅Added achievements for collecting wool.[/p]

notes.title: Cats Are Money is finally out! 🐾
notes.content: [p]I'm so excited to announce that Cats Are Money is finally here! 🐾 Collect adorable cats, build your farm, and enjoy countless fun moments with your furry friends.  A huge thank you to everyone who supported the game during development - your encouragement means the world and helped me finish my very first game![/p]

notes.title: 🎮My first game is almost here!🎉
notes.content: [p][b]⏳ In 1 days, my first game will be released, and I’m incredibly excited to share it with you! 🥳[/b][/p][p][b]To celebrate the launch, the game will be available with a 25% discount 🎉 at the start. Don’t miss out! 🚀[/b][/p]

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1005
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]A new update has just been released with new localization and much more![/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game! 💖[/p][p]🛠 New in this update:[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]✨ Added Spanish, German, and Chinese localization.[/p][p]✨ Added the option to switch to windowed mode.[/p][p]✨ Added the option for the game to continue running when minimized.[/p][p]✨ Added hint arrows when new locations are unlocked.[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]🛠 Fixes:[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]✅ Fixed the selling price for kittens.[/p][p]✅ Fixed a bug with effects.[/p][p]Thank you all for supporting the game! 💖[/p][p]Hope your kitties are happy! 🐾[/p]

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1004
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]A fresh update is here with new weather system, bug fixes, and overall improvements![/p][p]Thank you for playing and supporting the game 💖[/p][p]🛠️ New Content:[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]✨ Added a system of effects and cat states.[/p][p]✨ Added a weather system that influences cats.[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]🛠️ Bug Fixes:[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]✅ Fixed a bug that prevented progress during the cleaning stage in the tutorial.[/p][p]✅ Fixed a bug that limited clicks during cleaning after purchasing a new location.[/p][p]✅ Fixed a bug that allowed infinite purchases of already-owned food skins.[/p][p]-------------------------------------------------------[/p][p]Thank you for playing! 💖[/p][p]Your kitties are purring with happiness 🐾[/p]

notes.title: Dev Livestream & Ask Me Anything
notes.content: [p]I will be livestreaming the game during Steam Next Fest and answering any questions you might have.[/p][p][/p][p]Come have a chat with me! :D[/p]

notes.content: [p]Come join the livestream! I will playing a demo of my game and answering any questions you might have. Feel free to come chat with me about anything! :)[/p]

notes.title: Poop Hotfix
notes.content:
[h2]🛠 Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced the maximum number of poops that can appear on the map.
[*] Decreased the spawn rate of poops across all locations.
[/list]

notes.title: Cats Are Money Update 1003
notes.content:
[h2]✨ New:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a collection of cats and decorative items.
[*] You can now change cats' names.
[*] New skins for cat food have been added.
[*] Added a save reset button.
[*] Added wool production penalty for cats not in their native location.
[*] New cats and decorations have been added to the game!
[/list]

[h2]⚙ Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced upgrade costs.
[*] Updated tutorial for a smoother start.
[*] Text on some buttons now displays purchase status information.
[*] Offline wool generation has been made more efficient.
[/list]

[h2]🛠 Bug Fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed cats disappearing when changing locations.
[*] Fixed incorrect wool display when entering the game.
[*] Fixed food texture freezing during feeding.
[*] Fixed wool production multipliers in the tundra.
[*] Fixed hourly wool and love generation display.
[*] Fixed decoration duplication bug.
[*] Fixed automatic closing of cat info window.
[/list]

Thank you for playing! 💖  
Your kitties are purring with happiness 🐾
